description: Land Acquisition - Thulhiriya, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose. It describes the exact location, extent, and boundaries of the land to be acquired in the Village of Tulhiriya. The content is exclusively focused on land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which includes "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters." While a minister is named, this is incidental to the land acquisition notice itself, and the content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
